snippet.title: Robot Unicorn Attack 2 Exclusive Trailer for iPhone & iPad
snippet.description:
Check out the exclusive gameplay trailer for Robot Unicorn Attack 2! Get your hands on the latest, greatest, most epic installment of the Robot Unicorn Attack series to date, available for FREE in the App Store.  New for iPhone and iPad from Adult Swim Games.
itunes link: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/robot-unicorn-attack-2/id541672969?mt=8
